name: agent-prose
description: Writing-craft toolkit for coding agents: poems and song lyrics, game dialogue and barks, instructions and docs, textbook teaching and reader targeting, academic and professional prose, screen and stage scripts, YouTube scripts, speeches, professional presentations and webinars. Nineteen skills include prose-teach for textbook explanations and prose-reading-level for U.S. school audiences, alongside prose-presentation for evidence-backed slide plans, speaker notes and rehearsal, and prose-webinar for run sheets, moderator cues, interaction and demo recovery. Native drafts are measured and linted against cited craft rules. Illustrated storyboards retain editable panels, choices and character quest tracks. Variant sets, owner reviews and a taste model support rewrites; prose audit reports style hallmarks, never authorship. Slide-file creation uses the available presentation tool.
